title: [AUG-182] Live mode: Copy & Clear and Clear buttons, working Skip Clear Confirmation, hold-to-stop Stop Live
why_we_need_this: Rodion (Feature Request 3, @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md) can't manage the live window without losing text. The Dock Strip has only [ COPY ALL ] [ STOP LIVE ]. There is no way to copy and empty the window, and its STOP LIVE has no protection at all: one stray click ends Live and wipes the visible text (handleLiveStop, @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx:863-873). Settings already shows "Skip Clear Confirmation", but no code reads it. Research and the agreed design: AUG-175, mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-175/live-controls.html (option B, hold to stop).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Standard live panel (@client/src/components/LiveTranscriptPanel.tsx) top bar order: Pause/Resume, Mute mic, Copy All, Copy & Clear, Clear (renamed from "Clear All"), Stop Live, End Recording. Copy & Clear uses the green frame like Copy All; Clear keeps the red frame.
- [ ] Dock Strip tools row (@client/src/components/compact/DockWidgets.tsx) shows [ COPY ALL ] [ COPY & CLEAR ] [ CLEAR ] [ HOLD TO STOP ] and fits the 360 px strip without horizontal scroll.
- [ ] Copy & Clear writes the same text as Copy All to the clipboard and empties the live lines only after writeText resolves; if the write rejects, no line is removed. It never shows a confirmation.
- [ ] Clear empties only the displayed live lines: the recording, the live WebSocket, action items and participants stay unchanged, and the post-recording transcript is still produced from the audio.
- [ ] The existing pref skipClearConfirmation (default false) governs Clear in both views: false → an inline confirm (panel: existing confirm row; Dock Strip: "CLEAR TRANSCRIPT? [ YES ] [ NO ]"); true → clears at once. It reaches the Dock Strip through the compactStore snapshot.
- [ ] Stop Live in the standard panel and the Dock Strip is a hold-to-stop control: it stops Live only after 1.5 s of continuous press, shows a progress fill while held, and cancels on pointerup / pointerleave / pointercancel / blur before 1.5 s. Holding Space or Enter works the same, and keyup cancels. The old "Are you sure?" step for Stop is removed (confirmAction keeps only 'clearAll'). One shared hold-button component is used in both places, with 0 border-radius.
- [ ] Hold-to-stop is not affected by skipStopConfirmation, which keeps governing END only.
- [ ] compactStore actions gain copyAndClear and clearLive; Ghost Caption and Ghost Coin are unchanged.
- [ ] Settings → General → Confirmations: the Skip Clear Confirmation row gets a hint "Applies to Clear in the live panel and the Dock Strip. Copy & Clear never asks."
- [ ] `npm run build` (client) and the existing client and server tests pass; behaviour checked on Windows, with macOS noted as pending if not tested.
- [ ] Routes transcription/live-transcription, frontend-design and preferences are updated (Clear All → Clear, the Dock Strip row, hold-to-stop, skipClearConfirmation now wired); roadmap line updated.
important_constraints:
Mockup (agreed): @docs/mockups/AUG-175/live-controls.html, option B. Research: AUG-175-1vumny.
Client-only change, with no server or protocol change; the pref key skipClearConfirmation already exists (server allow-list @server/src/routes/preferences.ts:30), so no migration. No platform branches, but it must be checked on both Windows and macOS.
Out of scope: Ghost Caption / Coin controls (AUG-178), Ghost Stop Meeting (AUG-176 must reuse the same hold-to-stop component), and Stop Live keeping lines after stop (it still clears them).
Do not change Copy All output format (gap lines stay plain text). Do not add tests unless asked.
Roadmap: M2 Live session control.

## Revision 2 (user decisions 2026-11-03, after the first manual test)
User feedback: the stop mechanics were a "zoo" (hold in one place, Yes/No confirm in another, instant click elsewhere) and "Hold to Stop" vs "End Recording" names were unclear; Ghost Caption had no Stop Live button and its buttons had different widths.
Decided and implemented:
- Names: "Stop Live Text" (stops live transcription, recording continues) and "End Meeting" (stops recording, final transcript); compact labels [ STOP LIVE TEXT ] / [ END MEETING ].
- One stop mechanic: every stop control is a 1.5 s hold (HoldToStopButton / useHoldToStop) — live panel, circuit center node (END + red progress ring), Dock Strip, Dock Square, Ghost Caption, Ghost Coin. No Yes/No confirm for stops; early release shows a "Hold" hint. Global hotkey and tray still stop instantly.
- Clear keeps its Yes/No confirm governed by skipClearConfirmation. skipStopConfirmation removed from the client (Settings row, prefs type, compact snapshot, ghost state); the server allow-list keeps the legacy key.
- Ghost Caption: new Stop Live Text button (hold, ghost command 'stop-live'), tools in a 3-column equal-width grid. Ghost Coin: [ END MEETING ] hold, expanded width 372, electron ghost width clamp 380.
- This scope overrides the "Out of scope" line above for Ghost stop controls (AUG-176 stop protection and the AUG-178 Ghost Caption Stop Live / equal width are done here).
Verification: client build OK, electron tsc OK, server tests 585/585; Windows manual check passed (user, 2026-11-03); macOS check pending. Nothing committed.
